title: Coastal Reflections
summary: A quiet exploration of a seaside town, revealing its simple beauty and subtle mysteries.

descriptions: A small coastal town, bathed in sunlight, offers a sense of tranquility and introspection.

scene_blueprints.summary: Establishes the setting and introduces the overarching mood of quiet contemplation.
A lone building stands as a silent observer of the town's everyday life.
The rhythmic sound of waves and the distant cries of seagulls create a calming atmosphere.
A weathered bench invites reflection amidst the simplicity of the coastal landscape.
A final glimpse of the town, leaving the audience with a sense of peaceful solitude.
